title: APA and BUILT CoLAB organise Face-to-Face Training Action on “Construction and Demolition Waste Management” in Porto.

content:
Registrations are now open for the Training Action that APA – Portuguese Environment Agency and BUILT CoLAB, with the support of AICCOPN, are organising in person in Porto under the scope of the “Circularity in Construction” initiative.

📢 Presential Capacity Building Action | Construction and demolition waste management: what has changed? What is new?

📅 Friday 25 March | ⏰10:00 – 12:00 | 📌 AICCOPN Auditorium

Given the recent amendment of the General Waste Management Regime, this Training Action aims to support the application of the new regulations and promote a more circular management of construction waste. The action will address the main aspects for the compliance with the legal framework, the relevant changes compared to the previous regime, the applicable concepts and also the reporting obligations. At the end there will be a debate and question and answer period with audience participation.

Speakers:

Sónia Oliveira | AICCOPN

Rodrigo Gonçalves | APA – Agência Portuguesa do Ambiente

Paulo Fonseca | BUILT CoLAB

Patrícia Teixeira | APA – Agência Portuguesa do Ambiente

Mafalda Mota | APA – Agência Portuguesa do Ambiente

Participation is free, but registration required 👉 here.

This Capacity Building Action takes place under the Circular Agreement with the Construction Industry, the Collaboration Protocol promoted by the Ministry of Environment and Climate Action, between BUILT CoLAB and the Environmental Fund, with the participation of APA – Portuguese Environment Agency, and which also has the Confederation of Portuguese Industry (CIP) as partner entities, CPCI – Confederação Portuguesa da Construção e do Imobiliário, AICCOPN – Associação dos Industriais da Construção Civil e Obras Públicas, AECOPS – Associação de Empresas de Construção e Obras Públicas e Serviços, PTPC – Plataforma Tecnológica Portuguesa de Construção, and IMPIC – Instituto dos Mercados Públicos, do Imobiliário e da Construção, I.
